//SalarySlip
package Practice;
import java.util.*;
public class EmployeeSalarySlip {

	public static void main(String[] args) {
		// TODO Auto-generated method stub
		Scanner sc=new Scanner(System.in);
		
		System.out.print("Enter no. of employees: ");
		int n=sc.nextInt();
		
		String[] name=new String[n];
		int[] salary=new int[n];
		double hra;
		double da;
		double netSalary;
		double tax;
		
		System.out.print("Enter name of employees: ");
		for(int i=0; i<n; i++) {
			name[i]=sc.next();
		}
		
		System.out.print("Enter salary of employees: ");
		for(int i=0; i<n; i++) {
			salary[i]=sc.nextInt();
		}
		
		for(int i=0; i<n; i++) {
			hra=(20.0/100)*salary[i];
			da=(10.0/100)*salary[i];
			netSalary=salary[i]+hra+da;
			System.out.println();
			System.out.println("HRA of "+name[i]+" = "+hra);
			System.out.println("DA of "+name[i]+" = "+da);
			System.out.println("Net salary of "+name[i]+" = "+netSalary);
			
			if(netSalary>50000) {
				tax=(10.0/100)*netSalary;
				netSalary-=tax;
			}
			
			System.out.println("Final salary slip: "+netSalary);
			
		}
		
		

	}

}
